theorems.statement: ∀ (m q : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) q) (Ψ Ψ' : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ' s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = fderiv ℝ (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Continuous (fun s => X (Ψ' s)) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t => X (Ψ t)) (X (Ψ' s)) s) ∧ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (Ψ' s) = X (Ψ 1) - X (Ψ 0)
